name: Embedder
long_description: Embedder is an AI agent for embedded software. It reads your datasheets and schematics, writes the code, flashes the board, runs the tests, and fixes its own mistakes. Testing is hardware-in-the-loop: Embedder drives the equipment your team already owns (debug probes, logic analyzers, power profilers, oscilloscopes) and validates firmware on real silicon, not just against a compiler. Embedder works with some of the top semiconductor ecosystems in the world, supporting 500+ MCUs and 3,000+ peripherals.
one_liner: Hardware-Aware AI for Embedded Software Development
